blind.second_guess: low wooden bench or console table
blind.description: A stylized low wooden utility table or prep counter crafted in warm brown timber. It features a thick, beveled two-plank rectangular top supported by six sturdy square legs with flared base feet. Under the tabletop are two wide front drawers, each fitted with a centered wooden knob. Below the drawers spans a full-length slatted wooden storage shelf. Surfaces are clean, solid, and fully textured in a hand-painted fantasy style.
blind.from_above: A clean, elongated brown rectangle consisting of two thick wooden planks meeting along a central seam, with softly beveled corners and edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands around 1.8 to 2.0 feet tall (reaching roughly knee height on the 5 ft 9 in figure), with a length of about 5.0 to 5.5 feet and a depth of roughly 1.8 feet.
